prompt: State the definition of resultant force in terms of momentum.

mark_scheme.criterion: States the rate of change of momentum of a body. Accept change in momentum per unit time.

hints: Express force as a rate of change.
What quantity changes with time when a force acts?
solution: Resultant force is the rate of change of momentum of a body.
teacher_walkthrough: Emphasize that Cambridge defines force as rate of change of momentum.
Clarify that F = ma is a derived special case, not the fundamental definition.
